answer: The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 15 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. Because the tundra partition is computed from the lantern history, the dune audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. That is 25 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
